notes: Bipolar dual full bridge, VS up to 46 V, 2 A DC per channel, logic VSS 4.5–7 V. No internal clamp diodes: every output of a bridge that drives a motor, solenoid or relay needs a fast diode to VS and one to GND (four per bridge) – maker-coverage CK-15. Drop up to 3.2 V at 1 A, 1.8–3.2 W per bridge (maker-coverage MOT 1). For higher current outputs may be paralleled, channel 1 with 4 and 2 with 3 (figure 7). Mostly bought as the red 'L298N module' (with diodes, 78M05 regulator and screw terminals) – this entry is the IC; such a module is a part of its own (kind module, from its seller's schematic). No behaviour model for a bridge driver: behavior none. Library draft.

2026-10-31: outputs clamp = none – the L298 has no internal clamp diodes; its datasheet (January 2000, section 3, as read for the library draft) asks for diodes to VS and to GND per bridge output (CK-15)
open: the missing internal clamp diodes have no field in the schema (maker-coverage CK-15 names 'clamp: none'); REQ.missing (flyback) asks for one diode across a motor – for a bridge the datasheet's four diodes to VS and GND are what is needed, and a single diode across a winding driven both ways would short the bridge
VS minimum is 'VIH + 2.5 V' – depends on the input high level the circuit applies; v_op_min_v left out (pin hint)
the output's saturation voltage (total drop 3.2 V at 1 A, 4.9 V at 2 A) has no field – r_out_ohm does not describe a bipolar output (maker-coverage FT-6)
p_max_w: Ptot 25 W only at Tcase 75 °C (on a heat sink); without one LIM.t holds it through Rth j-amb 35 °C/W
drive tristate makes a motor net driven only by these outputs an LVL.undefined/open_drain warning – no pin type fits a bridge output
ViH max is VSS while VI abs max is 7 V regardless of VSS – whether an input may sit above VSS is not stated; vin_rel_max_v left out
